text:
lee: after the memcache incident, can we try a short 'closure sprint' approach for postmortem actions? thinking of forcing timeboxes and a lightweight escalation path.
aria: sounds promising. what's a closure sprint look like?
lee: idea sketch:
```
Sprint length: 2 weeks (closure sprint)
Day 0: postmortem published; each action gets a single owner + ETA (must be filled)
Day 2: owners confirm ETAs or IC reassigns (auto-escalate)
Day 7: mid-sprint async board update + blockers logged
Day 14: sprint review: verified vs dashboard; leftover items either closed as deferred or moved to next sprint with clear justification
Post-sprint: monitoring verification at T+30, regression review at T+60
```
tom: forcing a hard review at Day 14 will make teams decide rather than drift. low ceremony is key.
aria: how do we enforce owner confirmation?
dev-bot: Automation proposal: when postmortem is published, dev-bot creates a closure-sprint reminder for owners at T+48h and a mid-sprint check at T+7d. If owner does not confirm ETA at T+48h, dev-bot pings the IC and adds a temporary assignment tag.
sam: recommend a single-owner rule per action (no team-level owner). if a PR needs multiple reviewers, owner remains a single person who coordinates.
lee: metrics to track for the pilot: % actions with ETA at 48h, % actions closed in 14d sprint, number of escalations, average owner transfers.
aria: suggest a tiny "closure card" snippet for postmortems to be copy/pasted:
```
Card ID: C-YYYY-NNN
One-line: short summary
Owner: @user
ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
Sprint: sprint-<date range>
Status: todo/in-progress/blocked/done
Blocker: short note or link
Link: PR/issue/monitoring
```
tom: also suggest a short IC checklist for sprint start so the IC knows to verify owners exist and triggers dev-bot reminders.
lee: operational tasks to get this started:
- Add closure-sprint section to incident runbook (lee) 1wd
- Implement dev-bot reminder workflow (tom) 3wd
- Create closure-card template + sheet dashboard (aria) 1wd
- Run pilot for next 4 incidents and collect metrics (sam) 8wks

aria: i'll design the sheet with a quick filter for "stale >14d" and an owner history column. minimal columns only so teams adopt.
tom: dev-bot will support auto-escalation pings to IC and also post a weekly summary in #eng-oncall during the sprint.
sam: i'll run the metric collection and share a brief dashboard after pilot. can we require owners to update the card row before the mid-sprint check?
lee: yes, owners must update before T+7 check or it's auto-escalated. makes the consequence clear.
aria: one more idea: if an action is deferred after sprint review, require a short reasoning note and a new ETA or a formal "deferred" tag so we don't lose context.
tom: agreed. dev-bot can add a "deferred" label and record the note in the card history.
dev-bot: Reminder: closure-sprint confirmation scheduled in 48 hours for all owners on memcache-2026.
sam: ok let's pilot this for memcache-2026 and the next outage. low friction + clear consequences is the win.
aria: no objections, i'll post the sheet link once ready.
lee: thanks team. i'll open the runbook PR after aria posts the template so we have something concrete to link.
